tooltip.cosmicbreach.rimeglass.used: Used in: Crafted into Rime Thread.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.satchel.what: A bag that collects materials by itself and holds eighteen pieces of armor, weapons and tools.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.satchel.from: Comes from: forged at the Astral Forge (tier I) from Starhide x4, Starsteel Ingot x2 and Starbloom, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.seared_lumen_veniso: Seared venison. It fills you well.
Comes from: cooked from Lumen Venison in a furnace, smoker or campfire.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.seared_manta_fillet: A seared fillet. It fills you well.
Comes from: cooked from a Manta Fillet in a furnace, smoker or campfire.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.silent_sigil.what: A sigil of the Choir, pressed in silence.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.silent_sigil.from: Comes from: dropped by a boss on layer 3, the first time it falls.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.silent_sigil.used: Used in: The Dying Star Heart.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.singing_rimeglass.w: Rimeglass that glows and sings. Taken away, it falls silent and drops plain Rimeglass.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.singing_rimeglass.f: Comes from: found in the Rifts of layer 2.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.solar_ember.what: An ember of the last sun.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.solar_ember.from: Comes from: found in the west wing vault of the last hall, on layer 4.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.solar_ember.used: Used in: The Dying Star Heart.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.solar_heart.what: A heart of living sun. Using it on the Astral Forge raises the Forge to tier IV.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.solar_heart.from: Comes from: dropped by a boss on layer 4.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.solar_heart.used: Used in: Raising the Astral Forge to tier IV.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.spire_quartz.what: Pale quartz that crowns the spires.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.spire_quartz.from: Comes from: found on the spires of layer 1, and in reliquary vaults.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.spire_quartz.used: Used in: The Astral Forge, Meridian and Stable Crystals.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.stable_crystal.what: Use it on your tamed mount to keep it safe inside, and on the ground to set it down again.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.stable_crystal.from: Comes from: forged at the Astral Forge (tier I) from Spire Quartz x2, Starsteel Ingot and Starbloom, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.star_egg.what: An egg that hatches a familiar when it is kept warm in a Brazier of Solenne.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.star_egg.from: Comes from: found in the vaults of puzzle rooms on layers 1, 2 and 3.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starbloom.what: A flower that glows in starlight.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starbloom.from: Comes from: grows on the islands of layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starbloom.used: Used in: Saddles, Stable Crystals and the Satchel.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starbloom_seeds.fro: Comes from: crafted from a Starbloom, or found in reliquary vaults, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starbloom_seeds.use: Used in: Planted to grow Starbloom.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_chute.what: An opening in the ceiling that drops star-rocks in a pattern. Each glints before it falls.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_chute.from: Comes from: found in the traps of layer 3.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_codex.what: The Starfall Codex: a book that writes itself as you play. Sneak and use it to find your way.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_codex.from: Comes from: it falls from the sky when you first arrive.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_shard.what: Use it on a frame of a Breach Ring.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_shard.from: Comes from: broken from the fallen star, on the surface.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_stone.what: The white stone of the islands. It makes stone tools and a furnace.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_stone.from: Comes from: found in the islands of layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_stone.used: Used in: The Astral Forge and Brazier of Solenne.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_stone_bric: A slab of Starfall Stone Bricks.
Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Starfall Stone Bricks.
Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Starfall Stone Bricks.
A wall of Starfall Stone Bricks.
Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Starfall Stone Bricks.
Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Starfall Stone.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_stone_slab: Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Starfall Stone.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_stone_stai: Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Starfall Stone.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_stone_wall: Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Starfall Stone.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_vanguard_b: The boots of the Starfall Vanguard, armor for Power and Resilience.
Comes from: forged at the Astral Forge (tier I) from Starsteel Ingot x4 and Starshard, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_vanguard_c: The chestplate of the Starfall Vanguard, armor for Power and Resilience.
Comes from: forged at the Astral Forge (tier I) from Starsteel Ingot x8 and Starshard x2, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_vanguard_g: The greaves of the Starfall Vanguard, armor for Power and Resilience.
Comes from: forged at the Astral Forge (tier I) from Starsteel Ingot x7 and Starshard x2, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starfall_vanguard_h: The helm of the Starfall Vanguard, armor for Power and Resilience.
Comes from: forged at the Astral Forge (tier I) from Starsteel Ingot x5 and Starshard, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starhide.from: Comes from: dropped by wild Lumen Stags on layer 1 and wild Drift Mantas on layer 2.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starshard.from: Comes from: dropped by Shardlings on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starshard.used: Used in: Meridian, Starfall Vanguard armor and the Comet Maul.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_barding.w: Armor for a mount, worn in its armor slot. Armor 5.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_barding.f: Comes from: forged at the Astral Forge (tier I) from Starsteel Ingot x6 and leather or Starhide x2, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_block.wha: A block of nine Starsteel Ingots.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_block.fro: Comes from: crafted from Starsteel Ingots.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_ingot.wha: A bar of Starsteel, the metal of layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_ingot.fro: Comes from: smelted from Raw Starsteel. Also found in vaults on layers 1 and 2.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_ingot.use: Used in: Meridian, the Astral Forge and the Satchel.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_nugget.fr: Comes from: crafted from a Starsteel Ingot, or found in fallen rifts and vaults on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_nugget.us: Used in: Crafted back into an ingot.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_ore.what: Ore of Starsteel. A stone pickaxe is enough to mine it.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_ore.from: Comes from: found in the cores of the Shattered Spires, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_pickaxe.w: A pickaxe of Starsteel. It mines whatever an iron pickaxe does.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.starsteel_pickaxe.f: Comes from: crafted at a crafting table from Starsteel Ingots, on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.stripped_driftwood_: A driftwood log with its bark removed.
Comes from: made by stripping a Driftwood Log with an axe.
Stripped driftwood with the same face on every side.
Comes from: crafted from Stripped Driftwood Logs.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.sun_aperture.what: The opening in a Lens Array ceiling that lets a beam of sunlight fall onto the grid.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.sun_aperture.from: Comes from: found in Lens Array rooms, on layers 1 and 2.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.sunshard_compass.wh: A charm that points to the nearest vault you have not opened and shows every trap tell near you.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.sunshard_compass.fr: Comes from: rarely found in a vault on layers 1 and 2.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.sunstone.what: Pale gold glowing stone, the daylight panels of the old structures.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.sunstone.from: Comes from: found in the structures of layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.teal_neon_lichen.wh: Glowing lichen that lights the dark. Shears take it whole for torches and fuel.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.teal_neon_lichen.fr: Comes from: grows on the platforms of layer 3.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.torn_codex_page.wha: A page torn from a codex. Use it to read it.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.torn_codex_page.fro: Comes from: found in the chests of fallen rifts on layer 1.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.twin_comet_band.wha: A ring: one free air dash each time you leave the ground, and air dashes fly level and chain.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.twin_comet_band.fro: Comes from: found in a vault on layer 2.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbra_cantor.what: The Umbra Cantor: a longbow whose charged shots leave notes that join into chords.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbra_cantor.from: Comes from: given by a boss on layer 4.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_basalt.what: Black basalt, the stone of the Deep.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_basalt.from: Comes from: found in the platforms of layer 3.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_basalt_brick: A slab of Umbral Basalt Bricks.
Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Umbral Basalt Bricks.
Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Umbral Basalt Bricks.
A wall of Umbral Basalt Bricks.
Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Umbral Basalt Bricks.
Comes from: crafted or stonecut from Umbral Basalt.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_cap.what: A mushroom of the dark, and the food of layer 3. Eat it raw, or plant it on basalt.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_cap.from: Comes from: grows on the basalt of layer 3, and turns up when Neon Lichen is cut.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_emitter.what: A dark wall emitter that fires bolts along a tripwire when something crosses it faster than a walk.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_emitter.from: Comes from: found in the crypts of layer 3.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_silk.what: Pale silk spun in the dark.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_silk.from: Comes from: dropped by Hollow Stalkers on layer 3, and found in crypt vaults.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.umbral_silk.used: Used in: Choir Regalia and the Choir Astrolabe.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.void_pocket.what: The sealed room under a Void Rift tile. It opens when its guards are dead, or after a while.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.void_pocket.from: Comes from: found below the traps of layer 3.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.void_rift_tile.what: A cracked tile that gives way after a moment and drops you into a sealed room.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.void_rift_tile.from: Comes from: found in the traps of layer 3.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.warden_eye.what: An eye in the wall of a Lens Array room. Light sent into it calls hunters.
tooltip.cosmicbreach.warden_eye.from: Comes from: found in Lens Array rooms, on layers 1 and 2.
